page.overview:
Who is Stan Shunpike?

Stanley "Stan" Shunpike (born between 15 September 1974 and 14 September 1975)

On 14 September 1996, he was arrested and sent to Azkaban for being a Death Eater when he was overheard claiming to have inside information about the organisation, although in all likelihood, he was only fooling around. In 1997, he broke free from prison and joined the Death Eaters under the Imperius Curse.

Following Lord Voldemort's ultimate defeat, Stan awoke from the curse and eventually returned to his job on the Knight Bus.

Stanley was born between 15 September 1974 and 14 September 1975, and possibly grew up in inner London, as he had a strong accent. It is unknown if he ever attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, but, if so, he would have attended from 1986 to 1993, unless he was born in early September.
